en: This wood is as flimsy as a pair a' dime store boots.
ko: 이 나무는 잡화점 부츠 한 켤레만큼이나 약해.

en: A good ol' fashioned wall sconce, though it ain't powered by flame.
ko: 좋은 구식 벽 sconce인데, 불꽃으로 켜지는 게 아니야.

en: This lamp is cute.
A device that plays music.
Shelves filled with books on Hylotl topics. I can think of several things I'd rather do than readin' these.
ko: 하이로틀 주제 책이 가득한 선반. 이걸 읽는 것보다 하고 싶은 게 몇 가지 있어.

en: I can't wait to feed the lil' chickies!
ko: 꼬마 병아리들한테 먹이 주는 게 기다려져!

en: Hangin' yer feeder makes it so that the flock don't waste the food.
ko: 모이통을 매달면 무리가 먹이를 낭비 안 해.

en: Awwe, it's a young poultry feeder! I love hearin' the chirpin' of chicks!
ko: 어우, 어린 가금 모이통이야! 병아리 지저귀는 소리가 좋아!

en: Chickens love the various colours of this rainbow xylophone, I reckon. They peck at it to hear the sounds!
ko: 닭들은 이 무지개 실로폰의 여러 색을 좋아해. 소리 들으려고 쪼아!

en: Chickens love swingin' back 'n' forth just like I do with my rockin' chair!
ko: 닭들도 나처럼 흔들의자로 앞뒤로 흔드는 걸 좋아해!

en: Gettin' a lil' boost ain't so bad! Ladders are quite fun for chickens, as well!
ko: 살짝 올라가는 게 나쁘지 않아! 닭한테도 사다리는 재밌어!

en: This shop is sellin' farm animal eggs! Ooh, hopefully I got a few pixels to share!
ko: 이 가게는 가축 알을 팔아! 픽셀 좀 있길 바라!

en: Aye! Somebody needs help buildin' a farm! That sounds like a job for me, I reckon!
ko: 예! 누가 농장 짓는 걸 도와달래! 내가 할 일 같아!

en: This sewing machine here would fit just fine in a Novakid's home.
ko: 이 재봉틀은 노바키드 집에 딱 맞아.

en: I could go for a new, dashin' look. Then again, I seem to forget what style I prefer...
ko: 새로운 멋진 모습을 하고 싶어. 근데 내가 좋아하는 스타일을 잊는 것 같아...

en: This is just the right sorta container for keepin' your drink warm!
ko: 음료를 따뜻하게 유지하는 딱 맞는 용기야!

en: This gal's offering a mighty fine selection of clothes! Might think of gettin' myself a new look.
ko: 이 아가씨는 멋진 옷 선택지를 제공해! 새 모습을 갖출까 생각해봐.

en: Poor fella’s trapped in this ol’ computer and doesn’t even know it!
ko: 불쌍한 녀석이 이 오래된 컴퓨터에 갇혀서 그것도 모르고 있어!

en: The Supervoid, eh? It must be extra empty, right?
I'd rather forget such planets exist.
ko: 그런 행성이 존재한다는 걸 잊고 싶어.

en: No clue what this Halloween Humans keep talkin' about is, but they might like this planet.
ko: 인간들이 말하는 할로윈이 뭔지 모르겠지만 저들은 이 행성을 좋아할지도.

en: Heck, not even a whole crowd of Novakids can breach the darkness of those abyss planets!
ko: 이런, 노바키드 무리 전부로도 저 심연 행성의 어둠을 뚫지 못해!

en: I'd stay away from those permafrost planets til I get 'nuff thick wool clothin'.
ko: 두꺼운 양털 옷이 충분해질 때까진 영구동토 행성은 피할 거야.

en: Hell yeah, rolled cigarettes!
Lots of plastic bottles!
It's a funny looking bird! Quack, quack!
I can bookmark this woofie flag for quick teleportin'.
ko: 이 강아지 깃발을 북마크해 빠르게 순간이동할 수 있어.

en: Let's go to nowhere!
Grinned. Now we're talking!
Another plain ol' cooler.
Don't see many dog merchants round these parts
ko: 이 근처엔 개 상인이 별로 없어

en: Aren't that a pressure plate, eh?
Damn..this counter smell bad than friday's night at Saloon, lol
ko: 젠장.. 이 카운터 금요일 밤 술집보다 냄새나, ㅋㅋ

en: I'd reckon you could store near anything this ol' crate.
ko: 이 오래된 상자엔 거의 뭐든 넣을 수 있을 거야.

en: I reckon that sac's got a bunch of bugs inside. Ain't somethin' I'd want to poke around in.
ko: 저 주머니엔 벌레가 잔뜩 들었을 거야. 들춰보고 싶진 않아.

en: Hope I don't set that alight goin' near it...
Let's tread lightly, partner. Don't wanna spark trouble with that sac.
ko: 살살 밟자, 파트너. 저 주머니랑 문제 일으키고 싶지 않아.

en: That sac's probably full of creepy-crawlies. Not too keen on gettin' up close and personal.
ko: 저 주머니엔 기어다니는 벌레가 가득할 거야. 가까이 가고 싶지 않아.

en: Gotta watch out, partner. Wouldn't wanna ignite that there sac.
ko: 조심해, 파트너. 저 주머니에 불붙이고 싶지 않아.

en: Can't say I'm too eager to find out what's inside that sac.
ko: 저 주머니 안에 뭐가 있는지 알고 싶진 않아.

en: Can't say I like it.
Never did meet one of them 'pacas that wasn't easy to get along with.
That one can't bite, but I'm keepin' my distance anyway.
ko: 저건 못 물지만, 그래도 거리 두고 있어.

en: Hey there, little fella'! What brings you out here?
Eeyup, it's a board alright.
Probably the one in charge 'round these parts.
Well that's one way to get the whole town's attention.
ko: 온 마을의 이목을 끄는 한 가지 방법이네.

en: Yup. Stack of stuff.
Can't trust a single one of them richy-rich, gaudy, gold-eyed priests.
ko: 저 부자 부자스럽고 촌스러운 금눈 사제들 하나도 못 믿어.

en: Y'reckon it'll bounce if it gets knocked over?
I like this guy- he gets it.
Just like the saloon- except more eyes, and selling different stuff.
ko: 술집이랑 똑같아 - 눈만 더 많고 파는 게 달라.

en: Real good for target practice.
Getting right sick of all of these big-eyed space critters.
ko: 이 큰 눈 우주 생물들한테 진저리 났어.

en: Wranglin' practice, here I come!
Can't land a whopper without right proper equipment!
ko: 대어를 낚으려면 제대로 된 장비 없인 안 돼!

en: WoooOOOooOOOO- spooky!
Talked to me old grandmammy with one of these once. She was real angry, tell you what!
ko: 이런 걸로 우리 할머니랑 얘기한 적 있어. 진짜 화나셨다고!

en: Well hey there, little feller!
Reckon this frame's just for show?
ko: 이 액자는 그냥 장식인 것 같아?

en: What time is it? Any time's a good time, really.
ko: 몇 시야? 언제든 좋은 시간이야, 사실.

en: That there's a box for big ol' varmints.
Golly, that's a big one!
Some folks just can't stop overcomplicatin' everything- even bricks.
ko: 어떤 사람들은 벽돌까지도 지나치게 복잡하게 만들어.

en: Reckon this sign means there's meant to be an exotic varmint station 'round here.
ko: 이 표지판은 근처에 이국적 해충 스테이션이 있다는 뜻 같아.

en: Not a counter I'd use, but seems usable.
ko: 내가 쓸 카운터는 아니지만 쓸 만해 보여.

en: It's always a thrill to find an unopened chest, 'specially one like this!
ko: 미개봉 상자를 찾는 건 항상 짜릿해, 특히 이런 거!

en: Now what in tarnation is this? It sure ain't any chest I've seen.
ko: 도대체 이게 뭐야? 내가 본 상자가 아니야.

en: Is this a cookin' surface, or a workin' surface?
This here lodestone produces a weak magnetic field.
Well I'll be... an artificial magnetic field.
What is that railgun lookin' thing? Looks fun!
ko: 저 레일건 같은 건 뭐야? 재밌어 보여!

en: Those are some interestin' blueprints.
Augmentin'.
That pistol looks like a true hand cannon. Just imagine the kick the thing has.
ko: 저 권총은 진짜 핸드캐논 같아. 반동이 어떨지 상상해봐.

en: Not my style, but if I would wield a sword, I want one o' these..
ko: 내 스타일은 아니지만 검을 휘두른다면 이런 걸 원해..

en: That piece has a clock on it. What in tarnation? I'm interested.
ko: 저 부품엔 시계가 있어. 도대체? 흥미로워.

en: Usin' my old pieces for new iron? Sign me up!
This store's goods are spread all over the place. I might fancy myself a new outfit!
ko: 이 가게 물건이 온통 흩어져 있어. 새 옷을 갖고 싶을지도!

en: Lady's sellin' outfits made to get wet. Ain't that somethin'.
ko: 아가씨가 젖기 좋은 옷을 팔아. 대단하네.

en: Better keep that thing frozen!
This lazy fella just sleeps all night.
ko: 이 게으른 녀석은 밤새 자기만 해.

en: Busy as a bee.
Some dang annoying snowdog.
Hmm, this shroom looks mighty familiar...
I wonder where this varmint stores its gold nuggets?
ko: 이 해충은 금 덩어리를 어디에 보관할까?

en: My grandpappy used to ride pterodactyls. They can be ornery, these critters.
ko: 할아버지는 익룡을 타셨어. 이 녀석들은 고집 세.

en: This varmint keeps trying to pet me.
ko: 이 해충이 계속 날 쓰다듬으려 해.

en: What a fancy bird.
Weeehah! I'm gonna sell this legendary critter for a fortune!
ko: 이히야! 이 전설적인 생물을 비싸게 팔 거야!

en: There's a pesky moogle here.
Some dang funny skeleton.
This here gold flower is up to something...
ko: 이 황금 꽃은 뭔가 꾸미고 있어...

en: Some dang funny skull.
They use canaries in coal mines to check the air quality.
ko: 탄광에서 공기 질을 확인하려고 카나리아를 써.

en: I hope it doesn't suck blood.
What a creepy looking varmint. Looks like raw meat.
I used to see them bluebirds all the time at grandma's garden.
Them bluejays make a horrible racket!
There's a pesky chocobo here.
That there's the weirdest little clown I ever did see.
ko: 저건 내가 본 것 중 가장 이상한 광대야.

en: These fiery critters never lose them flames, they just burst into a new hatchling when they gets old.
ko: 이 불타는 생물들은 불꽃을 잃지 않아, 늙으면 새 부화체로 터질 뿐이야.

en: My grandpappy said he caught a golden rabbit once, but I didn't believe him until now!
ko: 할아버지가 황금 토끼를 잡았다고 했는데 지금까진 안 믿었어!

en: Look at this here funny green bird!
Lookie here at this funny bird!
This fella is awfully full of himself.
Unlike rabbits, which live in fields, these critters live far in the mountains, so they're not as pesky.
ko: 들판에 사는 토끼와 달리 이 생물들은 먼 산에 살아, 그래서 덜 귀찮아.

en: They make fer nice fur hats.
Shoo! Pesky wolves eat cattle!
Some good ol' sweet leaf.
Wouldn' you know it?  Those tiny people are offerin' a reward for savin' 'em!
ko: 알고 보니? 저 작은 사람들이 구해주면 보상을 준대!

en: An anvil with meat on it. Or is that meat?
Makin' blueprints will be easy with this.
This fancy lamp sure does impress.
Wonder what kinda numbnut came up with this.
That there's a snake.
I hope it don't bite.
I made a door that leads somewhere other than behind the door, but... My head hurts thinkin' 'bout it.
ko: 문 뒤가 아닌 다른 데로 이어지는 문을 만들었는데... 생각하면 머리 아파.

en: I can bookmark this crystal for quick teleportin'.
ko: 이 수정을 북마크해 빠르게 순간이동할 수 있어.

en: This here station lets me talk with the ship.
ko: 이 스테이션으로 함선과 대화할 수 있어.

en: Sure is a lot to look at.
Pretty flashy decor.
Just like back on the ranch, this one's fer birds though.
I'd love to fry them suckers up good.
I don't think towels have much use fer me.
ko: 수건이 나한테 별로 쓸모 없을 것 같아.

en: Somebody sure knows how to make use o' crystal.
Sure is some high quality leather.
Furnace for smeltin' ore.
Just a couple o' shiny stones.
Some kinda splashy statues spoutin' water.
What's with this coil-shape?
The only way is up.
Plays a purdy tune!
I prefer a gun myself, but these people probably don't care for that.
ko: 난 총을 선호하지만 이 사람들은 별로 안 그럴 거야.

en: Ya gotta cook somewhere.
